A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Curious? Good.

Does this prototype analyze my face?

No. It previews your photo locally and creates a card from the style mood and palette you choose. Suggestions are curated examples. There is no AI connection yet.

Is my photo private?

This prototype does not upload or store photos. Your selected image stays in this browser session. Downloading or sharing a card is your choice. The remove button clears it from the page.

Will it score my appearance or recommend jobs?

The concept focuses on styling choices. A photo cannot establish your skills or which job suits you. Future career or acting exploration should use interests, skills, and roles you choose.

Can I pay from any country?

Payments are not enabled here. PayPal supports receiving payments in Jordan, but payment methods depend on merchant eligibility, buyer location, currency, and account checks. Card guest checkout is not guaranteed for every visitor.
